summary: POST /v1/monitor/bing (Bing Search) is a typed command (bing), an MCP tool and an opt-in cited engine (bing-aioverview), with the body shape of google minus the Google-only fields: query, country, include.aioverview, include.html.
reason: cloro added Bing Search after the archived spec.json was taken, and the published openapi.json does not list it yet. A reprint from the archived spec drops the command; reprint from a spec that has the path, or keep these files.
validated_outcome: TestBingSendsBodyToEndpoint checks the path and body against a stub server; TestCitedReadsBingAioverviewSources checks that bing-aioverview is opt-in and reads result.aioverview.sources. cited keeps its four default engines.
